name: make_5_lvl3

input.prompt: Propose a retrosynthesis route to synthesize the molecule with SMILES O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O. The leaves on the retrosynthesis tree should be commercially available chemicals. A molecule's price is its frozen estimated cost in USD for 1 g, and the route cost is the sum across all leaf molecules. The route cost cannot exceed $9999.0. The final route should not surpass 5 steps.
